text: The harness must select either a fresh builder session per feature or one append-only session across features.
why: Both build arms are deliberate and preserve the same feature contract.
author: operator

text: Treat repository state plus the current feature contract, audit, and progress context as inherited build inputs.
why: Those durable inputs are required evidence, not hidden state.
author: operator

text: The auditor must record verified evidence and next-session notes for later builder sessions to consume as cross-session memory.
why: The harness owns that channel while the builder remains focused on repository work.
author: operator

text: Refine the plan beyond its first draft.
why: Critique and revision remove scope and verification defects before work begins.
author: operator

text: Prefer shell or file acceptance checks; use manual checks only where no executable oracle exists, and never for the first feature.
why: Executable evidence is strongest while some outcomes genuinely require human inspection.
author: operator
